description: Defines mapping strategies for converting various 'thing modify' commands into JSON-friendly formats within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages how different types of 'thing' modification commands are mapped for protocol adaptation, including creation, modification, deletion, ACL, attributes, features, and definitions.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommandMappingStrategies
classes.description: Provides singleton strategies for mapping 'thing modify' commands to JSON-compatible formats within Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes the map of string keys to JsonifiableMapper functions for different 'thing' modify commands.

methods.name: addTopLevelMappingStrategies
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for top-level 'thing' commands such as create, modify, delete, and policy modification.

methods.name: addDefinitionMappingStrategies
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies related to 'thing' definitions, including modifications and deletions.

methods.name: addAclMappingStrategies
methods.description: Adds mapping strategies for Access Control List (ACL) commands.

methods.name: addAttributeMappingStrategies
methods.description: Adds strategies for handling attribute-related commands.

methods.name: addFeatureMappingStrategies
methods.description: Adds strategies for feature-related commands, including modifications and deletions.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of this strategies class.

methods.name: createThingFrom
methods.description: Creates a 'CreateThing' command object from an adaptable input.

methods.name: modifyThingFrom
methods.description: Creates a 'ModifyThing' command object from an adaptable input.

methods.name: thingToCreateOrModifyFrom
methods.description: Extracts or constructs a 'Thing' object suitable for creation or modification from an adaptable.

methods.name: initialPolicyForCreateThingFrom
methods.description: Retrieves inline policy JSON for create operations if available.

methods.name: policyIdOrPlaceholderForCreateThingFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the policy ID or a placeholder for create operations.

methods.name: initialPolicyForModifyThingFrom
methods.description: Retrieves inline policy JSON for modify operations if present.

methods.name: policyIdOrPlaceholderForModifyThingFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the policy ID or a placeholder for modify operations.
